listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you have into flashcards you can really keep up with. Just scan a handout, import a PDF or paste notes; QuickStudy drafts cards, links each to its source and schedules them so you study only what needs review. (Sections match English; 10 free AI generations a month, 150 cloud generations a month for Pro, Anthropic's Claude deletes text within 30 days, auto-renewal unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, managed in Apple Account settings: all kept exactly.)

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy 2.0 has been reborn around daily study. ONE SESSION A DAY: Today shows only the due cards plus your weakest card; streaks count the days you study and each full study week earns a Streak Freeze. FROM PAGE TO CARDS, FASTER: scan with the camera, choose a photo, import a PDF or paste text; keep using the app while your cards are drafted; every draft is kept by default, tap to edit, swipe to remove. UNDERSTAND WHY: each card links back to the page and passage it came from; every answer explains why it is right, and missed cards come back tomorrow. NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE: QuickStudy is available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese; cards are drafted in the language of your notes, whatever language your iPhone uses; scanning reads pages in those languages and spell-checking follows the language of each page. QUICKSTUDY PRO: an optional subscription that lets you use 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; typing your own cards and every study mode remain free and unlimited; if data would leave the iPhone for drafting, QuickStudy asks first.
listing:release_notes.note: Rewritten for 2.0 on 2026-11-12 to cover the whole update. Reviewer fixed two lines: 'すべての答えに、正解の理由が付きます。' mixed です・ます with a noun-ending sentence and was translationese, now 'すべての答えに、正しい理由の解説付き。'; '任意のサブスクリプション' can read as 'any subscription', now 'オプションのサブスクリプション'.
